mapper.select: SELECT id, account_id, ledger_type, amount, balance_after, reference_type, reference_id, idempotency_key, occurred_at FROM quantpf_cash_ledger WHERE account_id=#{accountId} ORDER BY occurred_at DESC, id DESC
SELECT id, account_id, ledger_type, amount, balance_after, reference_type, reference_id, idempotency_key, occurred_at FROM quantpf_cash_ledger WHERE idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quantpf_cash_ledger (account_id, ledger_type, amount, balance_after, reference_type, reference_id, idempotency_key, occurred_at) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{ledgerType}, #{amount}, #{balanceAfter}, #{referenceType}, #{referenceId}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{occurredAt})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quantpf_cash_ledger WHERE reference_id=#{referenceId}
